title: Freedom of Movement After 2004: London, Vienna, Munich
grammar: Preverbs le- and el- in settlement, employment, and departure (letelepszik, elhelyezkedik, elvándorol)
goal: I can discuss the European Union freedom of movement and its demographic consequences for Hungary after 2004.
I can correctly use preverbs le- and el- to describe labor market placement, permanent settlement, and outbound migration.
I can contrast the dilemmas of 'brain drain' (agyelszívás) with cross-border commuting and international skill acquisition.
